# Dockit Astro snapshot

This documentation site is adapted from the public Dockit Astro/Starlight
template at:

<https://github.com/themefisher/dockit-astro/tree/991d8b687bfde9ae533740a11186f3550ab4ca01>

The pinned source revision is `991d8b687bfde9ae533740a11186f3550ab4ca01`
(the upstream `main` head captured for this fork). The upstream project is
MIT-licensed; its license is retained in this provenance record. dfrs keeps
the Starlight information architecture and adapts the content, navigation,
palette, package scripts, and deployment target for GitHub Pages. pnpm is the
repository package manager even though upstream also carries a Yarn lockfile.
